name: Defect

## What happens

<!-- One sentence. What you saw, not what you think causes it. -->

## What you expected instead

<!-- Kept separate from the above on purpose: the gap between the two is
     usually where the disagreement is. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- The smallest input that shows it, and the exact commands. A reproduction
     against the published package is worth more than one against a working
     copy, because it rules out the local installation. -->

```
mdcx --version
```

## What you ruled out

<!-- Optional and valuable. What you tried that was not the cause stops the
     next person repeating it. Several corrections here came from reports
     whose measurements showed the obvious fix was the wrong one. -->
